description: This file defines the internal class InvokableMethodDescription, which models an invokable method within the Orleans code generation context. The class includes methods for creating descriptions, extracting attributes, managing type parameters, and providing metadata about invokable methods, such as method IDs, base types, timeouts, and custom initializers. It's used in the context of code generation for Orleans grains, specifically for describing methods that can be invoked remotely.

classes.name: InvokableMethodDescription
classes.description: Models metadata and attributes of an invokable method in Orleans, including method IDs, base types, timeouts, and type parameters.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate InvokableMethodDescription with method id and containing type.
